prompt: In the input folder sales/ there is orders.csv, an export from our shop system. It is a bit dirty: prices sometimes have a ¥ sign and thousands commas, dates come as 2026-01-05 or 2026/1/5, region names sometimes have stray spaces or lowercase, a blank quantity means 1, and some orders appear twice (order_id is unique, so a repeated order is an export error). Build a workflow that cleans it and reports total revenue (quantity × unit price, in yen) per region and month. Write it as revenue_by_region_month.csv with exactly the columns region, month (YYYY-MM), revenue, and show it on the canvas. Run it.

Our support inbox export is in the input folder feedback/messages.csv (columns id, message; Japanese and English). Build a workflow that sorts each message into exactly one category: bug, billing, praise or feature_request, so the right team gets it. Write triage.csv with the columns id, category and show the result on the canvas. Run it.

input_files.feedback/messages.csv:
id,message
F01,The app crashes every time I open the camera screen.
F02,請求額が二重に引き落とされています。返金してください。
F03,"Love the new design, it is so much faster now!"
F04,Could you add a dark mode? My eyes hurt at night.
F05,ログインボタンを押しても何も起きません。
F06,I was charged for the premium plan after I cancelled it.
F07,サポートの方がとても親切でした。ありがとうございます！
F08,Please let us export reports as PDF.
F09,Sync stopped working since yesterday's update; my notes are gone.
F10,領収書の宛名を変更したいのですが、請求書はどこで見られますか？
F11,カレンダーと連携できるようにしてほしいです。
F12,"Best budgeting app I have used, thank you team."
